# Live fixture landing zone

Redacted observations from the frozen ChatGPT Desktop target live here. The latest
resume-live-stream evidence is `attempt-008-thread-resume-live-turn-stream.json`.

Each set must satisfy `../live-fixture-contract.json`, use fixture-local
pseudonyms, remove all user content and secrets before repository write, and
include proof that the probe controller alone was revoked during cleanup.

Raw captures, authentication material, pairing/MFA values, signatures and
account-correlatable identifiers must never enter this repository. A static
schema fixture or a locally fabricated envelope cannot fill this directory or
satisfy Gate P0.
